decisions.reason: The firm has publicly invested in and received positive customer feedback for this trommel screen, so escalation of commitment supports keeping it.
Despite slightly reduced online visibility, the firm has sunk costs into a multi-model product line and would likely persist until results clearly force a drop.
Its own product page in 2019 signals continued commitment and investment, and no negative results warrant abandonment under escalation logic.
The product line is prominently presented with a quantified application example, indicating visible commitment and no triggering event for withdrawal.
